description: This PHP script is the view layer for editing role information within the SuiteCRM system. It initializes the roles bean, retrieves and prepares data from the request, populates the template for editing role details, and manages module permission assignments through a dual list box interface.

classes.name: TemplateGroupChooser
classes.description: Handles the selection and display of modules that can be assigned or disallowed in the role editing interface.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Manages the tabbed interface for module permissions, facilitating retrieval of system modules for assignment.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: Utility class for client-side scripting to manage form validation and behavior.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves role record based on request parameter, preparing bean for editing.
